description: This file implements hashing functionalities for objects within the Git version control system, including hashing files, stdin input, and interacting with the object database.

methods.name: void hash_fd(int fd,const char * type,const char * path,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes the content from a file descriptor, computes its object ID, and outputs the hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: void hash_object(const char * path,const char * type,const char * vpath,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes a file given its path and processes it based on specified type and flags.

methods.name: void hash_stdin_paths(const char * type,int no_filters,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Reads file paths from stdin, unquotes them if needed, and hashes each file.

methods.name: int cmd_hash_object(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
